objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura por que el detalle SoftRestaurant del 01/07/2026 queda NO_CUADRA_REVISAR aun cuando encabezado, tickets y PAX coinciden. Medir residuos monetarios por ticket y su acumulado diario en 130MID, CIENFUEGOS y ESTELAR.

queries.name: 130mid_20260701_rounding_detail_diag
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    ch.folio,
    CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado,
    CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentoycortesia,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS descuento
  FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
  WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND tr.apertura < '2026-07-02 00:00:00'
    AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
l AS (
  SELECT
    h.folio,
    MAX(h.encabezado) AS encabezado,
    MAX(h.descuento) AS descuento,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN cheqdet dc WITH (NOLOCK) ON dc.foliodet=h.folio
  GROUP BY h.folio
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    folio, encabezado, productos,
    CAST(encabezado-productos AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ticket,
    CASE
      WHEN ABS(encabezado-productos) <= 0.05 THEN productos
      ELSE encabezado
    END AS detalle_estimado_post_ajuste
  FROM l
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS tickets,
  CAST(SUM(encabezado) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado_total,
  CAST(SUM(productos) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos_total,
  CAST(SUM(detalle_estimado_post_ajuste) AS decimal(19,4)) AS detalle_estimado_post_ajuste,
  CAST(SUM(encabezado)-SUM(detalle_estimado_post_ajuste) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_agregado_estimado,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(delta_ticket) <= 0.05 AND ABS(delta_ticket) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_residuo_tolerado,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(delta_ticket) <= 0.05 THEN delta_ticket ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(19,4)) AS suma_residuos_tolerados,
  SUM(CASE WHEN encabezado=0 AND ABS(productos)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_cero_con_detalle
FROM calc;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    ch.folio,
    CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado
  FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
  WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND tr.apertura < '2026-07-02 00:00:00'
    AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
l AS (
  SELECT
    h.folio,
    MAX(h.encabezado) AS encabezado,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN cheqdet dc WITH (NOLOCK) ON dc.foliodet=h.folio
  GROUP BY h.folio
)
SELECT TOP 50
  folio, encabezado, productos,
  CAST(encabezado-productos AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ticket
FROM l
WHERE ABS(encabezado-productos) <= 0.05
  AND ABS(encabezado-productos) > 0
ORDER BY ABS(encabezado-productos) DESC, folio
